title: Counit equation for the union complex
statement: Let p:Y→B be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let B and A be affine schemes, let g:A→B, let U,V be opens of Y, and let N be a quasi-coherent module on U∪V flat over B. Suppose StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen(p,g,T) holds for T=U,V,U∩V [def-pc-standard-single-flat-counit-presentation-on-open]. Use the standard derived categories of module sheaves. For every bounded-above termwise flat complex K on B and every supplied isomorphism e:R((U∪V)→B)_*(N[0])≅Q(K), there is an isomorphism t from Q(g* K) to the base-changed direct image of the ordinary pullback of N, such that the standard single-module base-change map equals Lg*(e.hom), followed by the pinned derived-pullback counit at K and t.hom. The complex K and isomorphism e are fixed inputs, not newly chosen witnesses.

proof.text: Obtain the two distinguished triangles with literal union, member and overlap comparison components from standardSingleFlatCounitUnionTriangles. Its hypotheses are exactly the three open presentation properties for this N.

The U and V comparisons give invertibility of their biproduct map (via biprod.mapIso). Transport along the second-component equality; transport overlap invertibility along the third-component equality. Apply Mathlib Pretriangulated.isIso₁_of_isIso₂₃ and the first-component equality to get invertibility of standardSingleBaseChangeMap on the union.
For the supplied K, use bounded-above termwise flatness to obtain K-flatness, and then counit_isIso_kFlat to get invertibility of the pinned pullback counit at precisely K.

In the fully proved generic helper unionEquation_factor, form a=asIso of the pullback of e.hom followed by asIso of the pinned counit. Set t=a.symm followed by asIso of the union comparison; inverse cancellation gives the factorization. Apply this helper to the actual three geometric maps. No complex or representing isomorphism is replaced. The helper unionEquation_isIso_of_eq transports the triangle component equations without unfolding geometric maps.

lean.statement:
theorem standardSingleFlatCounitUnionEquation
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    [IsAffine B] [IsAffine A] (g : A ⟶ B) (U V : Y.Opens)
    (N : (U ⊔ V).toScheme.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hN : N.IsFlatOver ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p))
    (hPU : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g U)
    (hPV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g V)
    (hPUV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g (U ⊓ V)) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard A.Modules
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard B.Modules
    ∀ (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings B.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero (K.X i))
    (hflat : ∀ i : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlat (K.X i))
    (e : (schemeDerivedDirectImage ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
    ∃ t : DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≅
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p) g)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p) g) N)),
      standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p) N g =
        (derivedPullback g).map e.hom ≫
          (SingleComplexBaseChange.counit g).app
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫ t.hom
